prerequisites: Basic knowledge of optics and optical systems impact on the light beam
Basic knowledge of electromagnetic radiation's interaction with matter
Knowledge of the heat treatment's issues and its impact on the changes taking place in the material

learning_outcomes.text: Acquiring knowledge of the construction and the laser processing operation's
Acquiring the ability to select the appropriate laser system to the task in
Independent acquisition of information and its use to solve engineering problems
He knows the principles of operation and construction of high-power lasers
He knows the laser beam forming systems and the interaction of radiation with matter
He is familiar with the scope of lasers in manufacturing
He can choose the right laser system for a given treatment process
Acting in an appropriate way with the specialized laser equipment
Depending on the desired process he is able to select the appropriate beam forming system

syllabus_topics: Laser beam forming systems and laser safety
Impact of the laser beam with matter
Use of laser scanning head for machining
teaching_methods: self study - preparation for laboratory class
self study - self studies and preparation for examination
assessment_rules: For lectures, the final grade (P) is based on the forming evaluation (F1), which is a test covering educational effects PEK_W01 - PEK_W03. For laboratories, the final grade (P) is the average of the forming evaluation (F1), which is a short exam covering educational effects PEK_U01 - PEK_U03.

J.C. Ion: „Laser Processing of Engineering Materials”, Elsevier, 2005
degree: Mechanical Engineering and Machine Building (I level, full-time)
